Your insight is the strategy: which customer, which bet, which no
Future leadership is about strategy, outcomes and customers
Would you let an agent post your weekly update?

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L5-L11 chunk 2 "Your insight is the strategy": 'the three of you' (L7 slide 2, 'Which of these will the three of you decide this week?') resolves to the product owner, designer and team lead named in chunk 1; chunk 4 "Would you let an agent post...": 'the loop' is unpacked by the three questions that follow it in the same paragraph; chunk 5 'Each good result' resolves inside the sentence. Closest to violating: chunk 1 'Each answer is one person's first draft' - 'answer' resolves to the three bullets directly above it in the same chunk.

chunk 5 "The more you trust it, the less you notice": 'On Day 2 each of you marked the one digest line you trusted least, and wrote down why' names the day and unpacks the beat in the same sentence; no 'the opening lecture'-style positional pointer to a file. Harm (callback aimed at a file whose position varies) absent: Day 2 is a fixed module-day label and the beat is described by its content.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 5: 'On Day 2 each of you marked the one digest line you trusted least' - resolves: curriculum/exercises/apt101-read-the-digest.md L35 '## Phase 2: Mark the line you trust least' and L41 'Ask Claude to write it down with your reason'; the exercise is in the Day 2 module. No other 'the X you did' references in the file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no live-demo or guess-before-reveal beat; chunk 5 questions ('What made you stop on that line?') ask for recall of a past exercise, no outcome is narrated before them and every setup sentence is verbed

rules_evaluated.evidence: Every chunk carries a self-standing claim: chunk 1 'None of them comes from the agent'; chunk 2 'The analysis does not choose'; chunk 3 'What stays is what nobody can hand the agent'; chunk 4 'Choosing which, for which work, is the job'; chunk 5 'The trust is deserved. The noticing still has to be designed.' Smallest chunk (chunk 1, ~100 words) still holds three role bullets plus a claim.

Chunk 4 header 'Would you let an agent post your weekly update?' vs body L9 (slide) 'Take the team's weekly update... So you move one level up' - the body answers the question with four graded levels, so the header is true of the chunk. Closest: chunk 3 header 'Future leadership is about strategy, outcomes and customers' - body L31 names exactly those three under 'What stays'.

grep -c -E '\bNot [a-z].*\. Not ' over the five slide files -> 0 in each. Closest: chunk 2 'Which outcome... Which customer... Which bet... Which good idea you say no to' - four-leg anaphora but each leg carries new concrete content (outcome, customer, bet, no), so the third-leg-new-content test passes. Chunk 5 'The trust is deserved. The noticing still has to be designed.' is a contrast pair, not 'Not X. Not Y. Z.'. No superlatives, no number-plus-retraction, no empty verb triplet (chunk 4 'draft only; post after one of you reads it; post on its own when the check passes; never without a person' - each leg is a distinct concrete rung).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body dialect scan: none of surface-as-noun, firing, compendium, forcing function, beat, mood in the five slides. 'stance question' appears only in the maintainer block (Learning line), outside the body. Closest: chunk 4 'designing the loop' - ordinary engineering vocabulary, and unpacked by the three questions after it.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Chunk 1 bolds 'The product owner', 'The designer', 'The team lead' (3 handles, each <=4 words, none a whole sentence); other chunks carry 0 bold. The per-slide count is over the <=1 budget but the harm (bold-lead-sentence monoculture) is absent: three role labels scan as a role list. Rule question, not a finding; see suggestion.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lecture is included at curriculum/trainings/agentic-product-teams-101/learn-faster-than-the-market.md L37 '[Lecture: Three jobs, rewritten](lectures/apt101-three-jobs-rewritten.md)', and the five slide files are inlined (expanded view shows 5 slide-file blocks); node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file ... -> 'slides: 5' so the checker saw all five chunks. Both-layout render not run by this judge.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-numbering.js --file curriculum/lectures/apt101-three-jobs-rewritten.md -> 'OK - 1 files, Phase/Step numbering consistent.' exit 0; no hand-numbered headers.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/lectures/apt101-three-jobs-rewritten.md -> 'OK - 1 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut.' exit 0; grep -n -i -E 'below|above|earlier|following|see ' over the five slide files -> no hits.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file ... --links -> no in-body cross-doc links reported; the only links are the five structural include paragraphs (lines 3,5,7,9,11), which are how the file inlines. Review surface only, never a gate.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/lectures/apt101-three-jobs-rewritten.md -> 'slides: 5 limits: 210 words / 6 bullets  oversized: 0' exit 0 (largest slide file is chunk 5, ~2.5KB).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lecture headings: chunk 2 'Your insight is the strategy: ...' and chunk 5 'The more you trust it, the less you notice' are claims. Closest: chunk 4 'Would you let an agent post your weekly update?' is a question and chunk 1 'What each of us is for when building gets cheap' a topic; headers are the maintainer's squint titles (STATUS L21 'headers are the squint titles') and the rule binds the claim requirement to law and consolidation slides, where a question hook that the body then answers does not waste the beat. Rule question, no finding.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: chunk 5 L (slide) 'So when the next result lands clean, ask the plain question: when did you last do this kind of work by hand?' follows 'Keep a habit of doing a piece of the work yourself now and then' - converts the habit into a prompt the room answers, so it adds a move. Chunk 4 'Choosing which, for which work, is the job.' is the only place the slide states its claim, so not a header-restating kicker. Chunk 3 para 2 overlaps chunk 2 ('which outcome', 'what they actually said') but adds the outcome/customer glosses and the leadership frame; not a doctrine recitation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: git log -p --follow on all five slide files: each '## ' header line appears once, as an addition at file creation (what-each-of-us-is-for, one-level-up, trust-grows-attention-fades at a6b8901c/f8c46df1; your-insight, future-leadership at b758b28b); no commit changes a header without its bullets. Header covered, body read: chunk 4 header promises 'would you let it', body answers with the four levels.

suggestions.now: - **The product owner** decides which idea is worth testing... / **The designer** knows... / **The team lead** agrees...
suggestions.proposed: - The product owner decides which idea is worth testing, and writes the signal that could say no. (and the same de-bolding for the designer and team lead bullets, which leaves the slide with zero bold)

notes: Slide files inlined; body is five include lines, so line numbers cite the include line of each chunk (raw L3,5,7,9,11) and chunk labels carry the slide content. Slide wording judged in slides/*.md by their own classes. Prefill had no prior instance, so all 17 rules authored here.
